subject: Northbridge: SIG questionnaire - control evidence & timeline
messages:
From: Amelia Chen <amelia.chen@northbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Northbridge: SIG questionnaire - control evidence & timeline

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this. Attached is our standard SIG intake (Northbridge_SIG_Template.xlsx) — we need a control mapping and sample evidence for controls flagged as high/medium risk. Scope: production inference endpoints, key management, data residency, and access logging. Two immediate asks from our security team:

- Can you provide a primary control matrix (control ID -> Redwood control -> artifact) by EOD Tuesday 2027-05-04?
- Can you deliver a redacted sample of access logs and a copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report or ISO 27001 cert (if available)?

Also flag any controls you cannot substantiate and provide a recommended compensating control or expected delivery date for artifacts. We will need a secure link for downloads (SFTP or Box preferred) and the HubSpot record for tracking.

We are aiming to complete the intake by May 14 for our procurement window. Please let me know the primary point of contact for evidence delivery and any lead times.

Best,
Amelia Chen
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
Northbridge Financial

Attachment: Northbridge_SIG_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Chen <amelia.chen@northbridge.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northbridge: SIG questionnaire - control evidence & timeline

Hi Amelia—

Thanks — we received the template and we can meet the May 4 preliminary mapping milestone for the high/medium controls. High-level plan below:

1) Control matrix draft (mapping + primary artifact name) — deliverable: control_matrix_20270502.csv — owner: priyom_das — ETA: 2027-05-04 EOD
2) Evidence binder (redwood_sig_binder_v1.pdf) — contains redacted copies and artifact index (SOC 2 overview, encryption spec, KMS proof) — owner: olga_petrov — ETA: 2027-05-06
3) Access logs sample (redacted) — sample_access_logs_2026-09.zip — owner: jonas_weber — ETA: 2027-05-06; will be shared over a secure Box link with download expiration
4) Outstanding controls & compensating controls — we will mark items that require legal redlines or product changes and include expected delivery windows in the matrix

A few clarifying questions so we can prioritize:
- Do you want the full SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 letter + control inventory? We prefer to share a redacted SOC 2 bundle; full reports often require an NDA/POA.
- For encryption provenance, do you need KMS audit events (showing key rotation timestamps) or a description + screenshots of KMS configs?

We will upload the initial matrix to a secure Box folder (link below) and open a HubSpot ticket per your reference.

Proposed secure Box folder (will be active when uploads complete): https://redwood.box.com/s/secure-share-7f3a2b
HubSpot ticket: HS-78912

If the delivery timeline looks good I will confirm and we’ll start routing evidence collectors.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Assurance Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

On Sat, May 1, 2027 at 11:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> A few clarifying questions so we can prioritize:
> - Do you want the full SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 letter + control inventory?
> - For encryption provenance, do you need KMS audit events (showing key rotation timestamps) or a description + screenshots of KMS configs?

Amelia / Olga — quick status and technical notes from my side:

- Control matrix: I have started the mapping and will attach the first-pass CSV (control_matrix_20270502.csv). That CSV will include columns: Northbridge_Control_ID, Redwood_Control, Evidence_File, Owner, Confidence (High/Med/Low), Notes.
- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II bundle (audit firm letter + control descriptions) in the binder. Full unredacted reports require an executed NDA from Northbridge legal.
- KMS / Encryption: We will provide a brief provenance packet (encryption_spec.pdf) plus KMS rotation events summary. If Northbridge needs raw CloudKMS audit logs, we will route through your secure SFTP after an evidence transfer agreement (simple MSA addendum) — this is standard for export of sensitive audit logs.
- Access logs: jonas is preparing a redacted sample. Logs will remove IPs and user identifiers, but will retain timestamps, request path, and token-type indicators for traceability.

Planned attachments on my next upload: control_matrix_20270502.csv, redwood_sig_binder_v1.pdf, encryption_spec.pdf (brief), sample_access_logs_2026-09.zip (redacted).

If Amelia confirms that an NDA is not required for the redacted bundles, we will proceed to upload the files to the Box link and notify procurement.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Attachment: control_matrix_20270502.csv (CSV)
From: Amelia Chen <amelia.chen@northbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.com, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northbridge: SIG questionnaire - control evidence & timeline

Hi Olga / Priyom —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the delivery plan. A couple of points from our side:

- The redacted SOC 2 bundle + control matrix is fine for intake; our legal team will request an NDA if we need the unredacted report. Please proceed with the redacted versions.
- For encryption provenance we specifically need confirmation that customer data keys are rotated at least annually and a statement of how key material is segregated between customers (KMIP/HSM or cloud tenant separation). A brief one-page statement is fine; screenshots are optional.
- Access logs sample: please ensure request/response size is visible (we use it to validate token exchange and data flow), and confirm that PII is not present.

Can you confirm you’ll upload the initial artifacts to the Box link by Thursday 2027-05-06 EOD? If so we’ll mark HS-78912 as in progress and schedule a short review call the week of May 10 — 20 minutes to walk the binder and clarify any follow-ups.

Thanks — look forward to the upload.

Best,
Amelia Chen
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
Northbridge Financial
